children: faces a $5.66 billion execution test with its proposed Braze acquisition, while shares stood at $245.13 on October 23, down approximately 2.06% at 11.40am EST on Friday on the company's AI ambition. The investor question is straightforward: how much additional cash can this purchase eventually generate?

Salesforce announced terms offering Braze Class A shareholders $47.50 per share in cash, valuing the transaction at approximately $5.66 billion on an enterprise-value basis. Braze brings about 2,770 customers and technology that helps marketers respond to customer behavior across digital channels. Completion is expected in fiscal 2028, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. Salesforce left fiscal 2027 guidance unchanged. That keeps the proposed acquisition out of the current-year growth story.

The valuation graphic puts Salesforce 30.47% below its $352.57 GF Value estimate, suggesting a valuation gap rather than guaranteed upside. Closing that gap takes execution. Braze could expand Salesforce's marketing reach, but customer retention, integration spending and additional sales will determine whether the deal earns its price. Watch for measurable cash-flow benefits and clear integration targets. A bigger product lineup matters only if it produces better economics.

title: Salesforce Stocks Decrease Over 2% as Braze Deal Sets a $5.66 Billion Hurdle
